memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports independent in all ADLs; manages auto-rickshaw driving and household chores without assistance. No difficulty climbing stairs or walking to market.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal). No evidence of cognitive impairment.
falls: No falls in the last 12 months. Gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds (<12 s), fall risk not raised.
medicines: 2 regular (levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD). Less than five medicines; no polypharmacy flag.
mood: Denies low mood, anxiety, or sleep disturbance; reports feeling well.
carers: Meena Kulkarni, spouse.
goals: "I want to stay seizure‑free and continue working as an auto‑rickshaw driver."

memories.text:

lamotrigine 50 mg PO BD

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Continues independent ADLs; reports occasional mild dizziness after prolonged driving, resolves with rest.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5; stable.
falls: No new falls. Gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds.
medicines: 2 regular (levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD).
mood: Denies depression; reports occasional frustration with dizziness.
carers: Meena Kulkarni, spouse.
goals: "I want to keep driving safely without seizures or dizziness."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs; drives auto‑rickshaw 6‑8 hrs/day, reports no dizziness since lamotrigine increase.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5; annual screen negative.
falls: No falls in past year. Gait steady, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (<12 s).
medicines: 2 regular (levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 100 mg BD). Less than five; no polypharmacy.
mood: Reports good mood, enjoys work.
carers: Meena Kulkarni, spouse.
goals: "I want to remain seizure‑free and keep supporting my family."

memories.text:

lamotrigine 100 mg PO BD

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve felt a brief light‑headed feeling twice in the last week when standing quickly from sitting. No loss of consciousness.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: ECG: Normal sinus rhythm, rate 78 bpm. No ST‑T changes, no QRS prolongation.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Neurology, Dr. S. Rao (M.S. Ramaiah Hospital) for review of epilepsy management and occasional light‑headedness.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Neurologist advises continue current regimen, consider checking serum levetiracetam level if symptoms persist; otherwise routine follow‑up in 6 months.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2026-08-15 at 10:00 AM with Dr. Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in all ADLs; drives auto‑rickshaw full‑time, reports no seizures or light‑headedness in past 3 months.
cognition: Mini‑Cog 4/5; annual screen negative.
falls: No falls in last 12 months. Gait steady, timed up-and‑go 9 seconds (<12 s); fall risk not raised.
medicines: 2 regular (levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 100 mg BD). Less than five; no polypharmacy flag.
mood: Denies depression or anxiety; reports good quality of life.
carers: Meena Kulkarni, spouse.
goals: "I want to stay healthy, keep working, and enjoy time with my grandchildren."
